notes.title: 🚨 DEAD STREETS: ZOMBIE BLITZ — OUT NOW! 🚨
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

The wait is over – Dead Streets: Zombie Blitz is officially LIVE! 🧟‍♂️💥

Get ready for intense action, epic battles, and a city overrun with zombies. It’s your turn to fight back and save the streets. We couldn’t have made it this far without your amazing feedback – thank you!

Grab your gear and jump in NOW! The undead are waiting.

Let’s go, survivors!

- Much love!
Happy Tube
